definitions.explanation: A massive, towering cloud formation that develops vertically and produces heavy rain, thunder, lightning, and sometimes hail or tornadoes. The formal meteorological term.

examples.japanese: {積乱雲|せきらんうん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}している→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧。
⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{積乱雲|せきらんうん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発達|はったつ}→発達：03559_hattatsu⟧しやすく、⟦{夕立|ゆうだち}→夕立：05862_yuudachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Cumulonimbus clouds tend to develop easily in summer, causing sudden evening showers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{気象庁|きしょうちょう}→気象庁：30107_kishouchou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{積乱雲|せきらんうん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{急速|きゅうそく}→急速：02634_kyuusoku⟧な⟦{発達|はったつ}→発達：03559_hattatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧よう⟦{呼|よ}びかけた→呼びかける：06480_yobikakeru⟧。
examples.english: The Japan Meteorological Agency called for caution regarding the rapid development of cumulonimbus clouds.

notes:
A compound of {積|せき} (accumulate) + {乱|らん} (turbulent) + {雲|うん} (cloud). This is the formal meteorological term used in weather forecasts and science education. In everyday Japanese, the same cloud type is often called ⟦{入道雲|にゅうどうぐも}→入道雲：10085_nyuudougumo⟧ (literally "priest cloud," referring to the bald-headed shape).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {積乱雲|せきらんうん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発達|はったつ}→発達：03559_hattatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: cumulonimbus clouds develop
- {積乱雲|せきらんうん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧: cumulonimbus clouds form
- {積乱雲|せきらんうん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧: watch out for cumulonimbus
- ⟦{発達|はったつ}→発達：03559_hattatsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧{積乱雲|せきらんうん}: well-developed cumulonimbus

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{入道雲|にゅうどうぐも}→入道雲：10085_nyuudougumo⟧: everyday name for towering cumulonimbus (summer cloud)
- ⟦{雷雲|らいうん}→雷雲：27189_raiun⟧: thundercloud (general term)
- ⟦{積雲|せきうん}→積雲：23702_sekiun⟧: cumulus cloud (the smaller, fluffy type)
- {乱層雲|らんそううん}: nimbostratus (rain-producing layer cloud)
